description: macOS shell catalogue for the user's terminal: the login shell ($SHELL), the text of /etc/shells and which candidates exist decide the list (default first) and the shell `shell:open` starts. The stock /etc/shells text is the guest's real file; paths are Apple's or Homebrew's, nothing identifying

cases.name: a stock Mac lists the login shell zsh, then bash and sh

input.etcShells:
# List of acceptable shells for chpass(1).
# Ftpd will not allow users to connect who are not using
# one of these shells.

/bin/bash
/bin/csh
/bin/dash
/bin/ksh
/bin/sh
/bin/tcsh
/bin/zsh
